title: Pure Psychic
summary: Pure Psychic unites the classic LP-paying and banishing EARTH/LIGHT Psychic Synchro toolbox—Serene Psychic Witch, Silent Psychic Wizard, Hushed Psychic Cleric, Esper Girl, Psychic Wheeleder, Psychic Tracker, and Overdrive Teleporter! When Serene Psychic Witch is destroyed, she banishes Esper Girl or Hushed Psychic Cleric from your Deck and Special Summons it on the next Standby Phase. Meanwhile, Tribute Summoning Overdrive Teleporter pays 2000 LP to Special Summon TWO Level 3 Psychic monsters directly from your Deck—instantly climbing into Magical Android, Psychic Lifetrancer, Thought Ruler Archfiend, Overmind Archfiend, Hyper Psychic Riser, and Miracle Synchro Fusion for Ultimate Axon Kicker while powering up Psychic End Punisher!

allow.Emergency Teleport: Iconic Psychic Quick-Play Spell that Special Summons any Level 3 or lower Psychic monster directly from your hand or Deck.
allow.Ghost Ogre & Snow Rabbit: Level 3 LIGHT Psychic Tuner that can be Special Summoned directly from your Deck by Overdrive Teleporter OR Emergency Teleport to serve as either disruption or a Level 3 Tuner!
allow.Naturia Beast: Level 5 EARTH Synchro (1 EARTH Tuner + 1+ EARTH non-Tuners: Level 2 Esper Girl + Level 3 EARTH Psychic!) that negates all opponent's Spell activations.
allow.Naturia Barkion: Level 6 EARTH Synchro (Level 3 EARTH Tuner Psychic Wheeleder + Level 3 EARTH Psychic!) that negates all opponent's Trap activations.
allow.Psychic End Punisher: Signature Level 11 LIGHT Psychic Synchro boss: unaffected by your opponent's activated effects while your LP are lower than or equal to your opponent's, banishes monsters, and gains ATK equal to the LP difference!
allow.Axon Kicker Oracle: Axon Kicker Oracle: Endboard boss featured on page analysis.
allow.Ukiyoe-P.U.N.K. Rising Carp: Level 8 Fusion engine that recruits two P.U.N.K. monsters directly from Deck.

main: Overdrive Teleporter

Signature Level 6 LIGHT Psychic boss (2100 ATK): once while face-up on the field, pays 2000 LP to Special Summon TWO Level 3 Psychic monsters directly from your Deck—instantly assembling Synchros while lowering LP for Psychic End Punisher!
Serene Psychic Witch
Core Level 3 EARTH Psychic recruiter: when destroyed on the field, banishes any Psychic monster with <= 2000 ATK from Deck and Special Summons it during the next Standby Phase!
Silent Psychic Wizard
Core Level 4 EARTH Psychic (1900 ATK): when Normal Summoned, banishes 1 Psychic from GY; when sent from field to GY, immediately Special Summons that banished Psychic monster!
Hushed Psychic Cleric
Core Level 3 EARTH Psychic (2100 DEF): sends 1 card from hand to GY to banish 1 Psychic from GY; when sent from field to GY, immediately Special Summons that banished Psychic monster!
Esper Girl
Level 2 EARTH Psychic Tuner: when Special Summoned from banishment, banishes the top card of Deck face-down; when sent from field to GY, adds that banished card to hand!
Psychic Wheeleder
Level 3 EARTH Psychic Tuner: Special Summons itself from hand if you control a Level 3 monster, and destroys 1 monster your opponent controls when used for a Synchro Summon!
Psychic Tracker
Level 3 EARTH Psychic non-Tuner: Special Summons itself from hand if you control a Level 3 monster, and permanently gives a Synchro Monster summoned using it +600 ATK!
Psychic Commander
Level 3 EARTH Psychic Tuner that pays up to 500 LP during damage calculation when a Psychic battles to reduce the opponent's monster's ATK/DEF by that amount.
Ghost Ogre & Snow Rabbit
Level 3 LIGHT Psychic Tuner that doubles as a handtrap and a target for Emergency Teleport / Overdrive Teleporter.
Emergency Teleport
Special Summons Psychic Wheeleder, Psychic Tracker, Serene Psychic Witch, Hushed Psychic Cleric, or Esper Girl directly from your hand or Deck.
Psychic Feel Zone
Returns 1 banished Psychic Tuner and 1 banished Psychic non-Tuner to your GY to Special Summon a Psychic Synchro Monster from your Extra Deck in Defense Position!
Miracle Synchro Fusion
Banishes 1 Psychic Synchro Monster and 1 Psychic monster from field or GY to Fusion Summon the 2900 ATK piercing, indestructible boss Ultimate Axon Kicker!
Brain Research Lab
Field Spell that grants an extra Normal Summon of a Psychic monster each turn and lets you place Psychic Counters instead of paying LP to activate Psychic effects!
